central_idea_and_construction: A warm personal-journaling identity: a compact symbol of two soft paper-tab shapes sharing a gentle curved inner gap sits above the exact words NOVA NOTES. The tabs are broad, rounded and slightly staggered like welcoming open pages, not a geometric bolt; just two shapes, no folded corners. Use custom rounded humanist serif uppercase lettering in two lines, NOVA above NOTES, with coherent modest contrast and open O/A counters. Symbol apricot, name warm plum. Symbol about one third the word width, with an airy clear gap above the two-line lettering. Overall compact vertical lockup 57% width and 67% height. No star, sparkle, speed line, diagonal cuts, tilted athletic type or extra slogan.
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Soft double-tab opening and two readable word lines.
specific_risk: Avoid a stock book icon and overly wide gap between symbol and name.
reference_transfer: Negative user screenshots analyzed as text: avoid severed slabs and nested squared Ls; no positive visual reference or borrowed signature.
observations: Recorded separately after viewing actual output.
